input.title: Lena Ama Mensah — LSE Master of Public Policy statement of purpose
input.body:
I am seeking the LSE Master of Public Policy to strengthen my quantitative evaluation skills for public policy. My goal is to return to West Africa to contribute to local-government finance and social-protection policy.

My academic preparation is a First Class BA in Economics from the University of Ghana, with an overall cumulative GPA of 3.78/4.00. My relevant coursework includes Econometrics I and II, Public Finance, Development Economics, Calculus and Statistics, with grades recorded in the academic transcript.

Since September 2022, I have worked in policy and research roles. At the Accra Metropolitan Research Unit, I worked on municipal revenue, social-protection targeting and quasi-experimental evaluation. Since March 2024, I have been a research assistant at the Institute for Fiscal Studies in London, continuing work in these areas. I also co-authored a published policy brief on property-rate compliance; the title and venue are not included in the supplied materials.

The programme’s quantitative public-policy orientation fits my preparation and aims. I can contribute £10,000 from savings and am applying for scholarships and other funding. I have no disciplinary findings.
